Your Book Publishing Journey, Made Simple

blocks.text: Authors Crew makes publishing easier by guiding you through each stage, from reviewing your manuscript and preparing the book design to selecting publishing platforms and completing the release. Our team keeps you informed at each step and provides the support you need throughout the publishing process.

sections.title: Complete Book Publishing Services Under One Roof

blocks.text: Every book has the potential to reach readers and make an impact. At Authors Crew, we bring together the publishing support you need to turn your manuscript into a finished book. Our team helps prepare your book for publication and take it one step closer to readers.

blocks.text: Whether you are publishing your first book or growing your author brand, our experts guide you through every step of the publishing journey.

sections.title: Where Great Stories Meet Global Readers

blocks.text: Our book publishing service transforms your manuscript into a professionally formatted eBook. Reach readers worldwide through major digital publishing platforms.

Give your book a voice and connect with readers in a new way. Authors Crew helps turn your written work into an audiobook, making your story accessible to listeners who prefer to enjoy books on the go or while doing other activities.

sections.title: Turn Your Manuscript Into a Bestseller

blocks.text: Get the publishing support, creative expertise, and global distribution your book needs to succeed.

Your book deserves the opportunity to reach readers wherever they choose to read. Authors Crew helps authors publish across recognised digital and print platforms, making their books available to audiences in different markets around the world.
Explore the Publishing Platforms We Support:

items.title: Amazon KDP Publishing
items.text: Publish your eBook and paperback through Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing. We help prepare your book for Amazon's publishing requirements, set up your listing, and organise the details readers use to find your work.

items.title: Barnes & Noble Press Publishing
items.text: Bring your book to Barnes & Noble's online bookstore through its self-publishing platform. We help prepare your print and digital editions, format your files, and set up your book for publication.

items.title: Apple Books Publishing
items.text: Make your eBook available to readers across Apple's ecosystem. We help prepare your manuscript, cover, and book details to meet Apple Books' publishing requirements and provide a smooth reading experience.

items.title: Kobo Publishing
items.text: Reach readers through Kobo's international eBook marketplace. We help prepare your digital book, organise its metadata, and set it up for distribution through the platform.

items.title: Google Play Books Publishing
items.text: Make your eBook available to readers through Google Play Books. Our team helps prepare your files and book information for listing, giving readers another way to discover and purchase your work.

items.title: IngramSpark Publishing
items.text: Expand your book's distribution opportunities through IngramSpark's publishing and distribution network. We help prepare your print and digital editions for distribution to participating bookstores, libraries, and retailers.

blocks.text: Explore our book publishing projects, discover the creativity behind each book, and get inspired to take the next step with your own story. Your book could be our next featured project!
